what: My experience does not establish an undisclosed joint preparation. Reports connect baker and freight, and sometimes neighbour, with vague bridge-or-port-change talk at the bakery, but give no concrete proposal, timing or tasks. Bread transfers and deliveries fit ordinary trade. The unexplained bakery lights are not linked to any identified organizer or occasion. Baker described ordinary freight business; neighbour explicitly distinguished hearsay from firsthand knowledge; builder reported no visible defects or work undertaken. Thus I cannot reliably identify participants, knowing helpers, or what is being prepared. I assign a low probability (0.18) to an undisclosed joint preparation being under way.
